query: Which drugs are used for MS in a young woman with optic neuritis and relapsing episodes of limb numbness?
rationale: Optic neuritis and relapsing sensory symptoms in a young woman are typical of multiple sclerosis.
rationale_id: Neuritis optik dan gejala sensorik yang kambuh-kambuhan pada perempuan muda khas untuk multiple sclerosis.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Multiple Sclerosis

query: MS in a patient with a history of rheumatic fever who has a low-pitched diastolic rumble at the apex and an opening snap.
rationale: Rheumatic fever is the leading cause of mitral stenosis; an opening snap followed by an apical diastolic rumble is its classic auscultatory finding.
rationale_id: Demam rematik merupakan penyebab utama stenosis mitral; opening snap yang diikuti bising diastolik di apeks adalah temuan auskultasi klasiknya.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Mitral Stenosis

query: MI in a 60-year-old smoker with crushing chest pain radiating to the left arm, sweating, and ST elevation on ECG.
gold_concepts: myocardial infarction (disease) [Disease]; myocardial infarction [Disease]; ST-elevation myocardial infarction [Disease]
rationale: Crushing chest pain radiating to the arm with ST elevation indicates acute myocardial infarction.
rationale_id: Nyeri dada seperti ditekan yang menjalar ke lengan disertai elevasi segmen ST menunjukkan infark miokard akut.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction

query: MI heard as a holosystolic murmur at the apex radiating to the axilla.
rationale: In valvular contexts MI stands for mitral insufficiency (regurgitation), whose murmur is apical, holosystolic and radiates to the axilla.
rationale_id: Dalam konteks katup jantung, MI berarti mitral insufficiency (regurgitasi mitral), dengan bising holosistolik di apeks yang menjalar ke aksila.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Mitral Regurgitation

query: What medications are available for AD in an elderly patient with progressive memory loss and difficulty finding words?
rationale: Progressive memory loss and word-finding difficulty in an elderly patient indicate Alzheimer disease, not atopic dermatitis.
rationale_id: Penurunan daya ingat yang progresif dan kesulitan menemukan kata pada lansia menunjukkan penyakit Alzheimer, bukan dermatitis atopik.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Alzheimer's Disease

query: MSA in a 54-year-old man with parkinsonism, orthostatic hypotension, and urinary incontinence.
rationale: Parkinsonism with prominent autonomic failure (orthostatic hypotension, urinary incontinence) is characteristic of multiple system atrophy rather than methicillin-sensitive Staphylococcus aureus infection.
rationale_id: Parkinsonisme dengan gangguan otonom yang menonjol (hipotensi ortostatik, inkontinensia urine) khas untuk multiple system atrophy, bukan infeksi Staphylococcus aureus sensitif metisilin (MSSA).
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Multiple System Atrophy

query: ALS in a patient with progressive asymmetric limb weakness, muscle fasciculations, and brisk reflexes.
gold_concepts: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis [Disease]; Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis [Phenotype]
rationale: Combined lower motor neuron signs (weakness, fasciculations) and upper motor neuron signs (brisk reflexes) indicate amyotrophic lateral sclerosis rather than advanced life support.
rationale_id: Kombinasi tanda lower motor neuron (kelemahan, fasikulasi) dan upper motor neuron (refleks meningkat) menunjukkan amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, bukan advanced life support.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis and Other Motor Neuron Diseases

query: PDA in a premature infant with a continuous machine-like murmur and bounding pulses.
gold_concepts: Patent ductus arteriosus [Phenotype]; patent ductus arteriosus [Disease]
rationale: A continuous machine-like murmur with bounding pulses in a premature infant is the classic presentation of patent ductus arteriosus, not the posterior descending artery.
rationale_id: Bising kontinu seperti mesin dengan nadi kuat (bounding) pada bayi prematur adalah gambaran klasik patent ductus arteriosus, bukan posterior descending artery.
source: Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics, 21st ed. - Patent Ductus Arteriosus

query: AML in an adult with fatigue, bleeding gums, pancytopenia, and Auer rods on the blood smear.
rationale: Auer rods in blasts with pancytopenia are characteristic of acute myeloid leukemia, not the anterior mitral leaflet.
rationale_id: Batang Auer pada sel blas disertai pansitopenia khas untuk leukemia mieloid akut, bukan anterior mitral leaflet.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Acute Myeloid Leukemia

query: RA in a woman with symmetric swelling of the small joints of both hands and morning stiffness lasting more than an hour.
rationale: Symmetric small-joint polyarthritis with prolonged morning stiffness is typical of rheumatoid arthritis.
rationale_id: Poliartritis simetris pada sendi-sendi kecil dengan kaku pagi yang lama khas untuk artritis reumatoid.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Rheumatoid Arthritis

query: A patient on high-dose morphine develops depression with slow, shallow breathing and drowsiness.
gold_concepts: Respiratory failure [Phenotype]; Respiratory insufficiency [Phenotype]; Hypoventilation [Phenotype]; Respiratory arrest [Phenotype]
rationale: Opioids cause respiratory depression; slow shallow breathing after morphine indicates respiratory depression. PrimeKG has no 'respiratory depression' node, so the nearest respiratory phenotypes are accepted.
rationale_id: Opioid menyebabkan depresi napas; napas lambat dan dangkal setelah morfin menunjukkan depresi napas. PrimeKG tidak memiliki node "respiratory depression", sehingga fenotipe pernapasan terdekat diterima sebagai jawaban.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Opioid-Related Disorders

query: Depression with persistently low mood, loss of interest in activities, and early-morning awakening for the past two months.
rationale: Persistent low mood and anhedonia for at least two weeks meet the core criteria of a major depressive episode.
rationale_id: Suasana hati murung yang menetap dan hilangnya minat selama sedikitnya dua minggu memenuhi kriteria inti episode depresi mayor.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Mental Disorders (Depressive Disorders)

query: The ECG shows horizontal depression in leads V4 to V6 during an episode of exertional chest pain.
rationale: Horizontal depression in ECG leads during exertional chest pain refers to ST-segment depression, a sign of myocardial ischemia.
rationale_id: Depresi horizontal pada sadapan EKG saat nyeri dada akibat aktivitas mengacu pada depresi segmen ST, tanda iskemia miokard.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Electrocardiography

query: Cold with a runny nose, sneezing, and a mild sore throat for three days.
rationale: Rhinorrhea, sneezing and mild sore throat describe the common cold (viral upper respiratory infection), not a temperature sensation.
rationale_id: Pilek, bersin, dan nyeri tenggorokan ringan menggambarkan common cold (infeksi virus saluran napas atas), bukan sensasi suhu dingin.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Common Viral Respiratory Infections
source_online_title: Upper Respiratory Tract Infections With Focus on The Common Cold - StatPearls

query: Cold in an elderly man found outdoors on a winter night, shivering and confused, with a core body temperature of 33 degrees Celsius.
rationale: Cold exposure with shivering, confusion and a core temperature below 35 degrees Celsius defines hypothermia, not a viral infection.
rationale_id: Paparan dingin dengan menggigil, kebingungan, dan suhu inti di bawah 35 °C merupakan definisi hipotermia, bukan infeksi virus.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Hypothermia and Peripheral Cold Injuries

query: Diabetes after a head injury with large volumes of dilute urine and intense thirst, while blood glucose remains normal.
rationale: Polyuria of dilute urine with normal glucose after head trauma indicates central (neurohypophyseal) diabetes insipidus, not diabetes mellitus.
rationale_id: Poliuria dengan urine encer dan kadar glukosa normal setelah cedera kepala menunjukkan diabetes insipidus sentral (neurohipofisis), bukan diabetes melitus.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Disorders of the Neurohypophysis

query: Shock minutes after a bee sting, with hives, wheezing, and a sudden drop in blood pressure.
rationale: Rapid hypotension with urticaria and bronchospasm after an insect sting is anaphylactic shock.
rationale_id: Hipotensi mendadak disertai urtikaria dan bronkospasme setelah sengatan serangga adalah syok anafilaktik.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Anaphylaxis

query: Shock in a child after two days of profuse watery diarrhea and vomiting, with dry mucous membranes and sunken eyes.
rationale: Severe fluid loss from diarrhea and vomiting with signs of dehydration leads to hypovolemic shock.
rationale_id: Kehilangan cairan berat akibat diare dan muntah dengan tanda dehidrasi menyebabkan syok hipovolemik.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Approach to the Patient with Shock

query: Infarction causing sudden weakness of the right arm and leg with slurred speech.
rationale: Sudden unilateral weakness with dysarthria localizes the infarction to the brain (ischemic stroke), not the heart.
rationale_id: Kelemahan satu sisi tubuh yang mendadak disertai bicara pelo menunjukkan infark di otak (stroke iskemik), bukan di jantung.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Ischemic Stroke

query: Ulcer with burning upper abdominal pain that improves after eating.
rationale: Burning epigastric pain relieved by food is typical of peptic (duodenal) ulcer, not a skin or pressure ulcer.
rationale_id: Nyeri ulu hati seperti terbakar yang membaik setelah makan khas untuk ulkus peptikum (duodenum), bukan ulkus kulit atau ulkus dekubitus.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Peptic Ulcer Disease and Related Disorders

query: Heart disease in an older patient with ankle swelling, breathlessness when lying flat, and waking up at night short of breath.
gold_concepts: heart failure [Disease]; congestive heart failure [Disease]; Congestive heart failure [Phenotype]
rationale: Peripheral edema, orthopnea and paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea are cardinal features of congestive heart failure.
rationale_id: Edema perifer, ortopnea, dan sesak napas nokturnal paroksismal merupakan gambaran utama gagal jantung kongestif.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Heart Failure: Pathophysiology and Diagnosis

query: Heart disease in a smoker with high cholesterol who gets chest tightness when climbing stairs that goes away with rest.
rationale: Exertional chest discomfort relieved by rest in a patient with risk factors is stable angina due to coronary artery disease.
rationale_id: Rasa tidak nyaman di dada saat beraktivitas yang hilang dengan istirahat pada pasien dengan faktor risiko adalah angina stabil akibat penyakit jantung koroner.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Stable Ischemic Heart Disease

query: Kidney disease with frothy urine, generalized swelling, and very low serum albumin.
rationale: Heavy proteinuria (frothy urine), edema and hypoalbuminemia define nephrotic syndrome.
rationale_id: Proteinuria berat (urine berbusa), edema, dan hipoalbuminemia merupakan definisi sindrom nefrotik.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Glomerular Diseases

query: Anemia in a woman with heavy menstrual periods, fatigue, and spoon-shaped nails.
rationale: Chronic menstrual blood loss with koilonychia indicates iron deficiency anemia.
rationale_id: Kehilangan darah menstruasi yang kronis disertai koilonikia (kuku sendok) menunjukkan anemia defisiensi besi.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Iron Deficiency and Other Hypoproliferative Anemias
source_online_title: Iron Deficiency and Microcytic Hypochromic Anemia - StatPearls

query: Anemia with yellow eyes, dark urine, an enlarged spleen, and a positive direct Coombs test.
rationale: Hemolysis (jaundice, dark urine, splenomegaly) with a positive direct antiglobulin test indicates autoimmune hemolytic anemia.
rationale_id: Tanda hemolisis (ikterus, urine gelap, splenomegali) dengan tes antiglobulin direk (Coombs) positif menunjukkan anemia hemolitik autoimun.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Hemolytic Anemias
source_online_title: Laboratory Evaluation of Immune Hemolytic Anemias - StatPearls

query: Arthritis with sudden severe pain, redness, and swelling of the big toe during the night after heavy drinking.
rationale: Acute monoarthritis of the first metatarsophalangeal joint triggered by alcohol is classic gout (podagra).
rationale_id: Monoartritis akut pada sendi metatarsofalangeal pertama yang dipicu alkohol adalah gout klasik (podagra).
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Gout and Other Crystal-Associated Arthropathies

query: Lung disease in a long-term smoker with a chronic productive cough and slowly worsening breathlessness.
rationale: Chronic productive cough and progressive dyspnea in a long-term smoker indicate COPD.
rationale_id: Batuk berdahak kronis dan sesak yang makin berat pada perokok lama menunjukkan PPOK.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease

query: Liver disease in a young adult with a hand tremor, personality changes, and brownish rings around the iris.
rationale: Liver disease with neuropsychiatric signs and Kayser-Fleischer rings in a young adult indicates Wilson disease.
rationale_id: Penyakit hati dengan gejala neuropsikiatri dan cincin Kayser-Fleischer pada dewasa muda menunjukkan penyakit Wilson.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Wilson's Disease

query: Cancer in a woman who found a painless hard lump with skin dimpling and nipple retraction.
rationale: A painless hard lump with skin dimpling and nipple retraction is a typical presentation of breast cancer.
rationale_id: Benjolan keras tidak nyeri dengan kulit berlekuk dan puting tertarik ke dalam merupakan gambaran khas kanker payudara.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Breast Cancer

query: Headache on one side, throbbing, with nausea and sensitivity to light, preceded by flashing zigzag lines in the vision.
gold_concepts: migraine disorder [Disease]; Migraine [Phenotype]; migraine with aura [Disease]
rationale: Unilateral throbbing headache with nausea and photophobia preceded by a visual aura is migraine with aura.
rationale_id: Sakit kepala sebelah yang berdenyut disertai mual dan fotofobia, didahului aura visual, adalah migren dengan aura.
source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th ed. - Migraine and Other Primary Headache Disorders
